prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Out Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice clicking, dragging, and hovering over your new pet before placing it on your desktop.", "Drag pet to move, right-click for controls menu."]
1: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Select a pet and listen to their voice personality preview.", "Choose Companion", "Play Voice Preview"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet adoption certificate and sync across desktop devices."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Canvas", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and graphic acceleration while your pet wakes up.", "Screen Overlay Permission Checked", "Rendering Pipeline"]
4: ["You can switch between custom generation and preset adoption anytime in settings."]
5: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Flip through fun desktop pet tips while we finish setting up your pet's animations.", "Pet Care Tips"]
6: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data", "Your pet progress automatically attaches to this account so your companions are never lost or reset.", "Continue & Sync Pet"]
7: ["Completion Sound Alert"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet's attributes and sign below to complete adoption."]
9: ["Welcome Home! Starter Reward Unlocked", "Your pet is live on your desktop! You've unlocked the Golden Collar accessory for completing setup.", "Golden Collar Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Asks the user to sign, which requests personal information
Mentions rewards and free extra gifts
